peer_review.independence: simulated peer (same model family) — prefer external /interrogate before fleet law

desk.name: Demo Encoder Desk
desk.rule: silent slide/demo mp4 batch for Origin ships + Thu reveal; honesty captions; videoReview before watched claims; Hold/Apply before publish
desk.pairs: brief-010 decides whether a reveal may speak; brief-025 decides how the silent reel is encoded, captioned, and proven-watched

honesty_captions.rule: every frame family carries LIVE | SYNTHETIC | MIXED; never hide SYNTHETIC for cleaner demo

stamps.SYNTHETIC: fixture / planted catalog / scripted Playwright / fake LLM
stamps.LIVE: real connector / real store / real Origin SHA captured against that state
stamps.MIXED: any mix; per-row badges required; reel caption stays MIXED

video_review.rule: never claim watched without videoReview receipt (frames_viewed == frames_extracted, transcript words, >=3 timestamped details); judge visual claims from frames not agent logs
forbidden_without_receipt: Looks good / LGTM on the video

publish.rule: auto_publish_demo=0; green ffmpeg is not publish Apply; videoReview is not publish Apply; burn may encode locally only

manifest_bind.rule: sha256 of mp4/webm/vtt/poster/transcript + git_sha + story_script + honesty + America/New_York encoded_at; attach fails on mismatch (pairs brief-010)

auto_publish_demo.rule: hard lock; Doctor / helper cannot heal by flipping publish after green encode

claim_watched_without_review.rule: hard lock; keyword skim / log skim is not watched

denied_tools: KPD / firm footage in TokenMax encode

reveal_honesty.rule: silent reels prove curated paths, not production readiness; LIVE scorecard cells require measured receipts (brief-010)
forbidden: silent reel cited as LIVE connector evidence
hiding SYNTHETIC chip in CSS for cleaner demo
docs-only we watched the video without videoReview

separation: brief-010 = adversarial reveal / demo-story webm + MANIFEST SHA / may-speak gates; brief-001 = Hold/Apply CAS; brief-008 = synthetic honesty; brief-012 = Draft Day / Origin ships; brief-018 = workspace CAS atomic publish; brief-025 = batch encode + caption honesty + watched-receipt specialization (auto_publish_demo=0 / claim_watched_without_review=0)
